facts.fact: 图书馆里 Gemma 截胡：Ben 现在救不了你——她来当说客。
Oliver 的闭合叙事：她要分数，我给了，她不再需要我。
facts.anchor: She wanted a good mark. I gave her that.

facts.fact: 他的底线：上次是他追出去的，这次不追，等她开口。
facts.anchor: I am not running after her again.

facts.fact: Gemma 递真相：演讲前导师就告知她奖学金申请误期。
facts.anchor: Her Honours coordinator stopped her beforehand

facts.fact: 同日考试：文学课的考试也在今天，两人将在考场再次同框。
facts.anchor: Contemporary Literature also has their exam today.

facts.fact: 三十排外他一眼认出她身上那件 university jumper。
facts.anchor: I would recognise my university jumper anywhere.

facts.fact: 看到她的瞬间：时间静止。
一个计划的边角开始进入他脑子。
